corrections.note: Q2-21 release showed interest expense of $89m including a $23m loss on debt redemption; the company presents the loss on its own line from the Q4-21 release (Q1-22 release panel: interest expense, net $66m; loss on debt redemption $23m). Split applied so that quarters sum to FY2021 ($259m / $146m).

31-Dec-2020 balance sheet per the 2020 Form 10-K (filed 16-Feb-2021): deferred income taxes $272m, total assets $11,443m, total equity $3,577m; the Q4-20 release (3-Feb-2021) showed $275m / $11,446m / $3,580m. Where the release and the 10-K differ, the 10-K wins.

guidance_fy26.src: Q3 2026 release (8-K Item 2.02 Ex. 99.1, 29-Oct-2026): FY2026 guidance increased; Q4 2026 guidance; FY2027 revenue ~$11.5bn (~+12% y/y)
guidance_fy26.note: All guidance used in the model is from the 8-K Ex. 99.1 release on EDGAR. No guidance from outside EDGAR (conference-call remarks, investor-relations site, sell-side) is used; any such figure would have to be marked unverified.

deals.cam: Consolidated Aerospace Manufacturing, LLC (CAM), bought from Stanley Black & Decker; closed 6-Apr-2026; cash price ~$1,812m net of $1m cash (Q3-26 10-Q Note C). Announcement 8-K 22-Dec-2025: FY2026 revenue ~$485-495m, adjusted EBITDA margin above 20% before synergies, ~13x FY2026 adjusted EBITDA after synergies and tax benefit. In Fastening Systems from Q2-26.
deals.brunner: Brunner Manufacturing Co. Inc. (fasteners, Wisconsin); acquired 6-Feb-2026 for ~$120m net of $2m cash (Q3-26 10-Q Note C). In Fastening Systems from February 2026.
deals.savannah: Sale of the disk forging facility in Savannah, Georgia (Engineered Structures) completed 31-Mar-2026 for $230m (~$225m received in Q1-26); gain $93m in Restructuring and other credits; net assets ~$92m incl. ~$41m goodwill (Q3-26 10-Q Note C).
deals.acq_sales: Organic-revenue reconciliation (releases): acquisitions contributed $135m to Fastening Systems sales in Q3-26; the Savannah facility had $34m of Engineered Structures sales in Q3-25.

ppa_note: Q3-26 10-Q Note C, preliminary combined allocation for CAM and Brunner: receivables $83m, inventories $159m, PP&E $204m, other noncurrent assets $49m, intangibles $425m; payables $40m, accrued compensation $14m, other current liabilities $10m, other noncurrent liabilities $23m; net assets $833m; goodwill $1,096m; cash paid $1,929m net of cash acquired (cash-flow statement). Shown in the Q2-26 column (CAM closing quarter; Brunner closed in Q1-26).

amort.src: FY2025 Form 10-K (intangibles note): amortization expense $32m (2025), $33m (2024), $35m (2023); expected ~$30-36m a year 2026-2030 excluding acquisitions. CAM / Brunner intangibles $425m (preliminary; useful lives not disclosed in the 10-Q).

debt.events: 3-Mar-2026: $400m 3.750% Notes 2028, $300m 3.900% Notes 2029 and $500m 4.750% Notes 2036 issued (net proceeds $1,193m) for the CAM acquisition. 22-May-2026: JPY term loan (¥29,702m, ~$186m) prepaid. Commercial paper program $1,000m; $1,000m five-year revolver (to Feb-2031) and $600m 364-day revolver, both undrawn. $250m receivables securitization (off balance sheet) unchanged.

buyback: Q3-26: $500m repurchased at an average $264.77 (1.9m shares); $1.1bn year to date to 28-Oct-2026 at an average $250.72. 28-Oct-2026: Board added $5bn to the program; $5.397bn authorized (Q3-26 release). Repurchased shares are retired.
dividend: Quarterly common dividend $0.14 from Q3-26 (declared 27-Jul-2026, +17% from $0.12). $3.75 preferred stock redeemed in Q4-25.
